√lag 'attach'
present: [1.] lagati etc. E.+ 
[perfect: lalāga alagīt ]
future: [1.] lagiṣyati etc. -- [2.] lagitā 
verbal: lagna E.+ lagitvā -lagya 
secondary: causative: lagayati lāgayati 
derivatives: -lagana laganīya C. liṅga? U.+ 
The lateness of this root is strongly opposed to the derivation from it of lakṣá etc.
